g.title: Shirt epaulet strap, right shoulder: sewn into the armhole seam at the shoulder point, lying along the shoulder line, seen edge-on as a band 0.46 in thick (the strap is 1.0 in wide), pointed at the collar end, button 1/2 in from the tip, topstitched (CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1 / 4.1.12.2, Figs 4.8, 4.10); the epaulet sleeve slides on over it

Shirt epaulet strap, left shoulder: sewn into the armhole seam at the shoulder point, lying along the shoulder line, seen edge-on as a band 0.46 in thick (the strap is 1.0 in wide), pointed at the collar end, button 1/2 in from the tip, topstitched (CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1 / 4.1.12.2, Figs 4.8, 4.10); the epaulet sleeve slides on over it
Blue web belt (CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1: blue belt with plain silver tip and buckle); flat strap with edge stitching

Open collar (top button undone): the shirt collar leaves spread by the open neck (the short sleeve's default; the tie is optional, CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1.3, 4.1.12.4; Figs 4.9, 4.10). Draw above the body; collar insignia sit on them

White V-neck undershirt seen in the open collar (CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1 / 4.1.12.2: a V-neck or athletic style white undershirt is worn under the shirt): the front, the ribbed V neckband and the inside back; clipped to the open V, under the collar leaves; hidden with the open collar when the collar is closed

Closed collar (top button buttoned, tie on): the closed neck and the two leaves closing on the knot, exactly as the long-sleeve sheet draws them; lies over the open collar and covers it (the short sleeve's second state; the tie is optional, CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1.3, 4.1.12.4)

Blue tie, the Class A coat's tie: knot under the collar junction, blade straight down the placket, the tip over the belt buckle (CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1.3, 4.1.8.3, Figs 4.6, 4.8); optional with short sleeves

rect.title: Nametag position (blank: cadet tags are blue, senior member tags silver) (CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1.2.1.4)
